items.title: A. O. Smith (AOS) Agrees To Transfer Majority Stake In China Business
items.summary: A. O. Smith (NYSE:AOS) agreed to sell a majority stake in its China business to CPE, while keeping a minority interest. The agreement includes a long-term license that lets CPE keep using the A. O. Smith brand in the Chinese market. The deal is expected to provide A. O. Smith with substantial cash proceeds that can be redeployed across its portfolio.
